source: Workflow reliability review F1-F8; sanitized handoff shapes only
qualification: hermetic; controlled provider decisions; real persistence, HTTP, Git and Temporal boundaries

cases.failure: source hashing blocks worker progress and exceeds the supervisor timeout
cases.invariant: one off-loop scan; bounded cached readiness; Temporal progress continues

cases.failure: default preset rejects its own claim after assessment
cases.invariant: omitted and explicit default inputs retain one SQL-backed attempt across registered activities, lost HTTP acknowledgement and replacement

cases.failure: heartbeat loss changes admissionEpoch from 1 to 2 under the same bridge request
cases.invariant: the replay branch reproduces the conflict; the new branch preserves one admission, runtime binding, bridge and semantic turn

cases.failure: Activity replacement cleans a still-owned provider session
cases.invariant: revoked delivery preserves live ownership; concurrent finalization publishes once

cases.failure: portable pr-resolver intermediate CI action is treated as terminal failure
cases.invariant: one cumulative continuation budget consumes the portable action, pushes corrected work and verifies the fresh head; actual deferrals remain blocked
the same candidate and profile are verified after service recovery with zero additional implementation attempts

cases.failure: cold resume loses unpublished Git history or misreads a repeated managed restore
cases.invariant: remote artifact read-back restores selected history and exact file evidence after source loss; repeated restore revalidates bytes and Git identity

cases.failure: cleanup saves a turn without compute; surviving candidate or partially staged index differs at finalization
cases.invariant: recorded turns resume verification without provider re-execution; saved candidate adoption verifies files, HEAD and index; archive restoration preserves staged and unstaged content separately

cases.failure: retained releases or stopped updater images defeat current-service verification
cases.invariant: image identity joins the normal running Compose service inventory; old or unknown current image identity still fails

cases.failure: release qualification cannot authenticate the existing protected dashboard and API
cases.invariant: startup-classified accounts mode validates an existing registered cookie or bearer session through real HTTP and PostgreSQL; missing, invalid and revoked sessions cannot qualify; probe receipts omit credentials

cases.failure: a module launched with python -m uses __main__ as the child module name
cases.invariant: both imported and __main__ entrypoints launch the canonical module and reconcile lost acknowledgements

cases.failure: promotion strands independently routed activities or in-flight release owners
cases.invariant: all queues qualify before CAS promotion; pinned and upgradeable histories preserve their server-authorized routing

cases.failure: release completes without proving the operator route, or repeats admission after verified primary success
cases.invariant: omitted defaults derive preserved fixed bindings; HTTP/TLS authority survives host transport; unknown access cannot complete; primary success owns cleanup-only resumption

cases.failure: dependency-only changes share a worker release identity
cases.invariant: copied dependency manifests, Dockerfile and verified source revision contribute to release identity

cases.failure: a failed brief read leaves an unannounced reservation permanently held
cases.invariant: all failed exits release only SQL-verified unannounced self-owned reservations; announced and inherited claims remain pinned

cases.failure: cleanup precedes terminal validation and a recorded provider turn is lost on retry
cases.invariant: revalidate durable turn evidence and publish the same saved candidate without a new billed provider turn
